title: Speculative decoding on our AWQ targets
subtitle: 2x RTX 3090 (24GB), TP=2. Qwen3.8-27B DSpark: SGLang v0.5.20, measured 2026-09-27 on the SHIPPED config (SPEC_DECODE=1: fp8_e4m3 KV, true 262144 window, 307K-token pool, bf16 draft). EAGLE3 / DFlash rows: v0.5.12, 2026-05-29, BF16 drafts.
footnote: DSpark rows: greedy, fresh prefill (flush_cache), 500-tok dense-prose outputs (400-tok code at 60-tok), 2 runs, median; 60-tok / 49K baselines = the same-day no-spec A/B, 130K / 250K baselines = the standing qwen38 depth sweep (bench_long_context, 100-tok outputs; 250K spec point at 250,550 actual vs 261,916). Live bake-off traffic (temp 1.0, opencode): accept length median 3.10 over the first 3,199 decode batches, 92 tok/s median. FP8 bars: not on this lane - the FP8 W8A8 MoE kernel does not compile on Ampere sm_86 (Triton rejects e4m3) and single-user decode is weight-byte-bound, so AWQ int4 wins even where FP8 is native (R9700: Coder-30B AWQ 56 vs FP8 38 tok/s). Receipts: benchmarks/quality/dspark-cuda-2026-09-27/, benchmarks/fp8-vs-awq-coder-reap.json.
